t: The Bosch Tile Diamond Disc, 115mm, is engineered for precise and reliable cutting of various tile materials. This diamond continuous rim blade is ideal for professional tilers and renovators working on bathrooms and kitchens, ensuring clean cuts in ceramics, porcelain, terracotta, granite, marble, and natural stone tiles. Its 22.23mm bore ensures compatibility with standard locking nut angle grinders. Manufactured to high quality standards, the optimised diamond matrix delivers consistent, solid results. Maximum 13,300rpm for efficient operation. Designed for dry use only.
b: For Porcelain, Ceramics, Terracotta, Granite, Marble & Natural Stone Tiles
